articles.chapeau: From Justice's original score to radio stations hosted by Bad Bunny and Lana Del Rey, here's a guide to the music of "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
From the sun-soaked synth-pop of Vice City to surfing a sea of radio stations, music has always been an essential part of Rockstar Games' gritty, open-world franchise. And with Grand Theft Auto VI taking players back to Vice City, the sprawling soundtrack is shaping up to be just as ambitious as the game itself.
Rockstar has already revealed a 34-track album featuring artists like Travis Scott, Cardi B, and PinkPantheress, along with an original score composed by the French electronic duo Justice. Meanwhile, the game's fictional radio stations are bringing some familiar voices to the airwaves, including Robyn, Bad Bunny, and Lana Del Rey.
And that's just what we know so far. Ahead of GTA 6 's Nov. 19 release , we're keeping track of every confirmed song, artist, radio station, and celebrity DJ coming to Leonida. Consider this your unofficial guide to the sounds of Vice City.
Rockstar has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , a 34-track collection of original music arriving Nov. 19, the same day as the game.
The album features an eclectic mix of artists and genres , from hip-hop heavyweights Travis Scott and Cardi B to country star Morgan Wallen and Puerto Rican singer Rauw Alejandro. There's even a collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and French producer Etienne de Crécy. And somehow, someway, Morgan Wallen's single is the most-streamed track from the soundtrack on Spotify, with more than 25 million streams. Yung Lean, fight back!
"Sexy Magic" — CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Étienne de Crécy
"Flower in a Hurricane" — Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA & King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
"Overtown Lights" — Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes & Robert Glasper
Fans can listen to the available singles on Rockstar's official GTA 6 music website , where the album is also available to pre-save or pre-order on vinyl and CD.
The French electronic duo Justice, consisting of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, is responsible for the original score of Grand Theft Auto VI .
Rockstar confirmed the news on Oct. 15 alongside the game's launch trailer , which features the debut of Justice's new single, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
It's a fitting collaboration for a game returning to Vice City, a fictional playground known for its vibrant nightlife and electronic music. Justice's signature blend of distorted synths, disco, and dance music feels particularly suited to Rockstar's radiant criminal underworld.
The duo previously collaborated with Tame Impala on "Neverender" from their 2024 album Hyperdrama . The song won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2025 Grammys.
Rockstar has also confirmed that an official score album is on the way, although additional details, including its release date and tracklist, have yet to be announced.
The fictional radio stations are one of Grand Theft Auto 's most beloved features, and GTA 6 is bringing some major star power to the airwaves.
On Oct. 8, Rockstar unveiled six radio stations , each with its own musical identity and celebrity hosts. Among the biggest names are Bad Bunny, Robyn, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, and members of Slayer.
Here's a breakdown of the confirmed stations and their hosts :
Bad Bunny is bringing the sounds of Puerto Rico to Vice City. Alongside singer RaiNao, the superstar hosts Cocoteo FM, a station dedicated to modern Latin music, including reggaeton and other Caribbean sounds.
A familiar name for longtime Vice City fans, Flash FM returns with Swedish pop icon Robyn and model Alex Consani behind the microphone. The station promises a steady stream of pop music and dance-floor favorites.
Country music gets its own corner of Leonida with Back Country Radio, hosted by Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey. In perhaps the most unexpected casting choice, Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, also makes an appearance as the station's " roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and airboat captain ."
Afrobeats superstar Burna Boy teams up with DJ and producer Palms Trax for a station spotlighting amapiano, African classics, and other sounds from across the continent.
Metal fans aren't being left out. Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya host The Chamber , a station dedicated to heavy metal.

articles.chapeau: Aux Grandes Gueules, Jordan Bardella se présente en gamer et qualifie GTA 6 de « jeu d’une génération ». RTT, arrêts maladie et Beaujolais nouveau s’invitent dans le débat.
articles.txt:
Aux Grandes Gueules, Jordan Bardella se présente en gamer et qualifie GTA 6 de « jeu d’une génération ». RTT, arrêts maladie et Beaujolais nouveau s’invitent dans le débat.
Quand un responsable politique national s’affiche en fan de Grand Theft Auto VI , cela fait forcément réagir. Invité des Grandes Gueules sur RMC, le président du Rassemblement National Jordan Bardella a été désigné « gameur du jour » et interrogé sur la sortie de GTA 6 . Sa réponse a immédiatement enflammé les réseaux sociaux.
À quelques jours d’un lancement présenté comme le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de 2026, la France parle RTT, arrêts maladie et spoilers plutôt que simple divertissement. Entre punchline de plateau et chiffres hallucinants pour Rockstar Games , que révèle cette séquence sur la génération GTA ?
À 31 ans, Jordan Bardella ne botte pas en touche. À la question de RMC « vous allez y jouer ? », il répond : « Je vais l’essayer, je ne vais pas dire le contraire. Je l’attends… c’est le jeu d’une génération. Ceux qui ont mon âge et qui ont joué à Vice City ou à San Andreas joueront évidemment à GTA VI ».
Cette séquence « gameur du jour » dans les Grandes Gueules tranche avec l’image traditionnelle des responsables politiques, souvent montrés loin de la culture vidéoludique. Elle renvoie aussi au passé de youtubeur gaming du patron du RN, connu sous le pseudo Jordan9320 pour ses vidéos de Call of Duty .
En assumant ce côté joueur, Jordan Bardella se place dans la même case que des millions de trentenaires qui ont grandi manette en main sur PlayStation 2. Le message est clair : il partage les mêmes références pop culture que les électeurs nés dans les années 1990.
Quand Jordan Bardella parle de « jeu d’une génération », les chiffres donnent du poids à la formule. La franchise Grand Theft Auto a écoulé environ 500 millions d’exemplaires depuis 1997, dont plus de 230 millions pour GTA 5 . Pour GTA 6 , RMC évoque un développement sur 13 ans, un budget proche du milliard de dollars, soit environ 930 millions d’euros, et plus de 10 millions de précommandes .
Pour les joueurs qui ont découvert la saga avec Vice City et San Andreas sur PS2, ces épisodes ont été synonymes de liberté totale en monde ouvert , radio à fond et codes secrets griffonnés sur un cahier. Aujourd’hui, GTA 6 arrive comme la suite naturelle de cette histoire, attendue au tournant le jeudi 19 novembre 2026 sur consoles.
Autour de RMC, l’émission Estelle Midi évoque un salarié joueur sur quatre prêt à poser un RTT pour la sortie de GTA 6 afin d’éviter les spoilers et de binge-gamer dès la première nuit. De quoi valider la boutade de Bardella sur une vague d’arrêts maladie.
Pour d’autres, comme le chroniqueur Jean-Philippe Doux , « l’événement c’est le Beaujolais nouveau », pas GTA 6 . Cette sortie montre surtout que le jeu vidéo divise encore entre générations .

articles.t: GTA 6 dévoile 6 images inédites en HD de la météo dynamique de Leonida et ses effets sur le gameplay
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 arrive dans 48 heures et pour l'occasion, ce sont six nouvelles images en HD consacrées à la météo de Leonida qui sont dévoilées. Les clichés
articles.txt:
GTA 6 arrive dans 48 heures et pour l’occasion, ce sont six nouvelles images en HD consacrées à la météo de Leonida qui sont dévoilées. Les clichés montrent aussi bien de fortes pluies que du brouillard, des orages ou encore une tempête tropicale dans plusieurs zones de la carte. Et bien évidemment, cela influencera le gameplay.
Rockstar dévoile six nouvelles images HD de GTA 6 montrant la météo dynamique de Leonida, avec pluies, brouillard, orages et tempêtes tropicales. La météo influencera directement le gameplay, avec routes glissantes, vagues, turbulences, visibilité réduite et PNJ qui cherchent un abri. Contrairement à GTA 5, les phénomènes météo seront localisés et évolueront en temps réel selon les zones, le vent, l’humidité, l’heure et les saisons. GTA 6 sort dans 48 heures , aussi bien sur Xbox Series que PS5, même si les joueurs de la console de Sony se méfient de codes déjà utilisés dans la boîte à cause d’une faille . Mais quoi qu’il en soit, c’est la fin d’une longue attente et le 19 novembre prochain, ils seront des millions devant leur écran pour parcourir Leonida.
Et justement, la carte de GTA 6 proposera de nombreux effets météorologiques qui influenceront les déplacements des véhicules mais aussi le comportement des personnages non-joueurs qui promettent d’être réaliste . C’est The Weather Channel, soit la chaîne météo des États-Unis, qui a publié les six images sous forme de vrai bulletin météo pour Leonida. Tout cela après les 39 images 4K dévoilées récemment .
Owen Shepherd, vice-président de l’art de la lumière et du rendu chez Rockstar, explique que GTA 6 a pensé sa météo pour qu’elle soit « plus localisée, persistante et surtout dynamique ». Leonida s’inspire de la Floride où le climat varie très rapidement selon les zones . Les images montrent donc différents effets de la météo dynamique sur la carte de Leonida dans GTA 6.
Les six images montrent notamment une pluie très forte qui réduit la visibilité sur la route , avec des réflecteurs pour suivre la voie lorsque le joueur conduit dans les Keys. L’orage peut assombrir les marais et rendre les alligators dans l’eau bien plus difficiles à repérer.
South Ocean Beach peut disparaître sous un épais brouillard marin et près du Rusty Anchor, l’image montre qu’il est possible qu’une tempête tropicale soulève la mer. Quant à Gambit Bay, cette zone de Leonida peut se couvrir d’une brume basse. Et Key Lento est une région où l’on peut voir de la pluie et du vent.
Gardons toutefois en tête que ce ne sont pas des météos fixes selon ces zones et qu’il y aura de nombreux effets climatiques partout sur la carte et de manière localisée. Et pour cause, Aaron Garbut, codirecteur de Rockstar North, explique que les nuages se déplacent séparément et qu’une tempête peut se former au loin puis atteindre les villes.
Le vent a aussi une influence sur l’état de la mer . Il y a également la prise en compte des îles ou des bâtiments qui protègent certaines zones et modifient donc les vagues ou la manière dont un bateau bouge sur l’eau.
Idem pour un avion et un hélicoptère qui, lorsqu’ils traversent une forte tempête dans GTA 6, peuvent subir des turbulences. Il est même possible que rester trop longtemps abîme légèrement l’appareil. Les personnages non-joueurs réagiront aussi à la météo et chercheront un abri lorsque le temps se dégrade.
Rockstar a évidemment pensé aux petits détails puisqu’après une averse, les routes sont toujours humides avec des façades qui gouttent et des surfaces qui sèchent à leur propre rythme. La météo laisse donc des traces visibles après son passage.
Le vent pourra aussi soulever les débris, plier l’herbe et créer des mouvements sur l’eau . On trouvera aussi des flaques après la pluie, des arcs-en-ciel lorsque la lumière revient. Rockstar a construit une météo différente selon les zones de Leonida.
Dans GTA 5, la météo se basait surtout sur le soleil, la pluie ou un ciel couvert appliqués sur la carte entière. GTA 6 va donc plus loin avec des phénomènes météorologiques qui évoluent dans l’espace et interagissent avec le décor. Une zone peut être sous le soleil alors qu’un orage se forme à quelques kilomètres.
GTA 6 tiendra aussi compte de l’heure, de l’humidité, du brouillard et des saisons pour faire évoluer les nuages et le vent. Les six images partagées par The Weather Channel montrent aussi d’autres détails de la carte comme le programme Vice-Pass et des panneaux vers Hamlet, Catalan Key et plusieurs grands axes de Leonida.

articles.t: How To Play GTA 6 a Day Earlier on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X
articles.chapeau: The New Zealand trick is once again coming into the spotlight thanks to GTA 6; and yes, we can all use it to play GTA 6 early
articles.txt:
20 photos Photo: Rockstar Those living in New Zealand are so lucky. They are always among the first countries to celebrate the New Year (the first is the Pacific island nation of Kiribati, though), and now, they’ll be the first to be able to play the all-new, so eagerly anticipated GTA 6. GTA 6 is already available for download for people who pre-ordered the game, but it’ll remain locked until November 19 at midnight. This means GTA 6 is already on your console, but you can’t touch it yet. It’s like a Christmas gift that you got in advance but you can’t unwrap it until Christmas day.
Fortunately, there’s a way to unwrap this present a day early. It involves what is commonly referred to as the New Zealand trick, a method that allows us to gain access to certain digital goodies a few hours or even nearly a few days in advance.
In this case, the New Zealand trick comes down to changing the settings of our consoles to look like we live in New Zealand. As a result, Rockstar’s servers would be tricked into thinking we’re actually allowed to play the game at midnight in New Zealand even if we’re now located in the United States.
Before I detail the steps to apply the New Zealand trick on your PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, let’s discuss the most pressing matter on this topic. Will changing my location lead to Rockstar banning my account?
Some people seem to be worried that tricking Rockstar into thinking they should be playing the game earlier would lead to a ban, but there’s literally no reason for the company to turn to such a decision. Changing the console settings shouldn’t be considered a violation of its policy, especially considering the method involves - as you’ll discover in a few seconds - buying Grand Theft Auto 6 from the New Zealand version of the store.
Both methods assume that you haven’t already pre-ordered GTA 6 on your console from another region. You must buy GTA from the New Zealand store on your console for this trick to work .
Photo: Rockstar Games How to switch to New Zealand on an Xbox The method is quite simple and straightforward on Xbox, and we should all thank Microsoft for not caring much about people changing their location settings.
The first thing you must do is sign into your Xbox account on your console - this must be the main profile. Next, go to console settings and look for the System section. Tap the “Language & localization” menu and look for New Zealand in the list.
Apply the settings and restart your console. When your Xbox boots back, you should now be connected to the New Zealand store. Just open the store app, look for GTA 6, buy the game, download the necessary files and wait for the New Zealand midnight to be able to play the game.
Your friends in the United States will still have to wait up to several hours, while you’re busy exploring Leonida.
As a summary, here’s what you need to do on your Xbox to enable the New Zealand trick:
Sign in with primary account > Settings > System > Language & localization > New Zealand > Restart Xbox > Xbox Store > Buy game > Download
Photo: Rockstar Games How to switch to New Zealand on PlayStation 5 While applying this trick on an Xbox takes only a few seconds, the method is a lot more complex on PlayStation 5. And it starts with the creation of a new account based in New Zealand.
You’ll obviously be required to enter a New Zealand address, but Google is your friend this time. Create this account, log into it, and go to settings to enable “console sharing and offline play.”
You’ll need to reboot your console to make all these changes. When you’re back, you need to go to the PlayStation Store to buy GTA 6, download, and install the game. Wait until midnight in New Zealand to play the game.
There’s one more problem, though. The PlayStation Store might not accept your US credit card to pay for the game and require a New Zealand card. If this happens, you can either use a service Revolut (though I’m seeing mixed results with this option) or get a PSN gift card and add credit to your account to purchase the game.
Here’s the summary of all these steps for the New Zealand trick on PlayStation 5:
Create account with New Zealand address - Sign in with this account > PS5 settings > User and accounts > Enable console sharing and offline play > PlayStation Store > Buy game (either with credit card or using a PSN gift card) > Download

articles.t: Xbox & DJ Khaled "Prescribe" a Day Off to Play GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Players can now get a joke "prescription" from Dr. XBOX to take a day off when GTA 6 launches.
articles.txt:
Players can now get a joke "prescription" from Dr. XBOX to take a day off when GTA 6 launches.
Xbox has come up with a humorous way to help players take time off to play GTA 6. The company has teamed up with DJ Khaled, now known as Dr. XBOX, who gives players "medical advice" to take a day off.
"After extensive research (and a whole lot of gaming), I've come to one conclusion: there's a serious case of Vitamin G deficiency around the world. And I'm here to tell you that the cure is simple," he writes . "Take. The. Day. Off." is his prescription.
He writes that a big week in gaming is coming, and it's not the best time to be distracted by emails or anything unrelated to gaming.
"I'm officially prescribing a day dedicated to doing what you love: staying home, picking up that controller and playing XBOX. No distractions. No interruptions. Just you, your favorite games and the freedom to experience the biggest week in gaming the way it was meant to be experienced," Dr. XBOX states.
Everyone can get a personalized "prescription" on DrXBOX.com . The Verge's Tom Warren shared on X/Twitter what the prescription looks like:
Of course, the document isn't real. Xbox has added a disclaimer that it is not responsible if a player's employer doesn't have a sense of humor.
However, some companies have been giving their workers real-life days off specifically to play GTA 6 : Palworld developer Pocketpair grants its employees five days, and Logitech gave its employees a day off, calling it Logi Game Day.
The new GTA will include many new features, and apart from highly realistic graphics, smart NPCs , and rich wildlife with over 170 animal species , it will have a different tone and encourage empathetic player behavior .

articles.t: GTA 6 jour J : la checklist avant minuit le 19 novembre
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre à minuit : préchargement, 212 Go à libérer, manettes, réglages, cloud Xbox One. La checklist pour être prêt.
articles.txt:
Plus que quelques jours avant GTA 6 . Le jeu se débloque le jeudi 19 novembre 2026 à minuit , heure locale : Rockstar n’a pas prévu de lancement mondial simultané, donc en France, ce sera à minuit pile, heure de Paris.
Voici la checklist à suivre pour être prêt à jouer sans mauvaise surprise.
Rockstar propose une édition Standard et une édition Ultimate, qui ajoute des contenus en jeu. Une fois le jeu précommandé, le préchargement permet d’installer les 212 Go à l’avance. Si vous ne l’avez pas encore fait, notre guide explique comment précharger GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Les joueurs qui ont acheté un exemplaire physique utilisent le code de la boîte, expédiée depuis le 12 novembre.
Pensez à votre connexion : selon votre débit, le téléchargement peut durer de quelques dizaines de minutes à plusieurs heures. Nous détaillons les durées et le rôle du Wi-Fi dans un autre article.
Le jeu occupe 212 Go, et je conseille de garder en plus 50 à 100 Go de marge pour les captures d’écran, les vidéos et une éventuelle mise à jour de lancement, que Rockstar n’a pas exclue. Sur une Xbox Series S, qui n’a que 512 Go de stockage interne, la place sera vite comptée : supprimez dès maintenant les jeux que vous n’utilisez plus.
Chargez vos manettes avant minuit, ou prévoyez des piles de rechange : jouer branché est possible, mais le câble limite le confort. Profitez-en pour régler la console : nos conseils pour la PS5 et la PS5 Pro (VRR, 120 Hz, HDR, audio 3D) valent aussi, en partie, pour la Xbox.
N’oubliez pas de vérifier les mises à jour système, sans lesquelles le jeu ne se lancera pas.
Les joueurs restés sur Xbox One pourront jouer en streaming, avec des heures limitées : voici ce qu’il faut savoir . Ce streaming ouvre à 7 h à Paris, soit sept heures après la version installée.
Le 19 novembre est un jeudi : si vous le pouvez, prenez votre journée du lendemain, ou au moins ne prévoyez rien de crucial après la sortie. Beebom recommande aussi de bien dormir avant minuit, car la première session risque de durer, et de garder à portée de main eau et en-cas. Ces conseils ne mangent pas de pain.
GTA 6 suit Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos dans l’État fictif de Leonida, inspiré de la Floride. Rockstar a dévoilé 26 minutes de jeu avec An Extended Look , mais n’a publié ni carte ni dimensions officielles. Sur console, le studio vise 30 images par seconde , avec l’upscaling PSSR et des ombres en ray tracing sur PS5 Pro.
Il n’y a pas de version PC au lancement : une sortie début 2027 est évoquée . Pour en savoir plus, consultez notre dossier complet sur GTA 6 .

articles.t: PS5 Update 26.07-14.23 Pushed Out on November 17; Days Before GTA 6 Releases
articles.chapeau: Days before GTA 6 is released, the PS5 has received mandatory system update 26.07-14.23, and this is to plug security loopholes.
articles.txt:
Add as preferred source Sony has once again pushed out a new PS5 firmware update today, November 17, and we can’t say we’re surprised at this.
Players will be prompted to download PS5 update 26.07-14.23, and this is another mandatory system update and clocks in at 1.2 GB.
With Grand Theft Auto 6 releasing in two days’ time, and the game getting an update yesterday that brought it to version 1.002.1, after the homebrew community has made headway into cracking the PS5 14.22 firmware, it seems likely that this is another patch to ensure no shenanigans will happen.
The short changelog isn’t surprising, as Sony won’t go into detail on how they beefed up the security of the console. Make no mistake about it: this is tied to GTA 6’s release, which is expected to be the biggest video game release of all time.
Expect PS5 firmware 26.07-14.23 to be mandatory in order to boot up GTA 6, which is Sony’s way of fending off the homebrew scene that’s actively trying to crack the PS5.
We wouldn’t be surprised if we see more updates for GTA 6 released leading up to launch, and even more PS5 system updates either.
In related news, it’s now confirmed the PS5 Pro won’t be able to output GTA 6 at 40fps, but it will still feature added features .

articles.txt:
Rencontrez des personnages hauts en couleur dans la dernière aventure en monde ouvert de Rockstar, toujours aussi marquée par le crime.
Grand Theft Auto 6 s’annonce comme la plus grande sortie de divertissement de l’année, à tel point que d’autres jeux ont déplacé leurs dates de sortie pour éviter d’arriver en même temps et d’être complètement éclipsés par ce mastodonte du jeu vidéo, développé par une équipe mondiale d’artistes et de programmeurs, et non plus seulement par le studio écossais Rockstar North des épisodes précédents.
Suite à l’aperçu prolongé du jeu diffusé sur Netflix en août, nous en savons un peu plus. Les deux personnages principaux ont été introduits dans la première bande-annonce du jeu : Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos forment le cœur de l’intrigue, qui se déroule principalement à Vice City, au sein d’un État américain fictif nommé Leonida et largement inspiré de la Floride. Lucia, originaire de Liberty City et récemment sortie de prison, débarque dans l’État de Leonida à la poursuite du rêve insaisissable d’une vie meilleure. Désireuse de s’affranchir de son passé, elle voit en son association avec Jason une voie vers la liberté et la prospérité. Jason apporte sa propre expérience de la rue à ce duo. Ayant grandi parmi des escrocs professionnels et doté d’un parcours ancré dans le trafic de drogue, il comprend les réalités brutales du milieu illicite. Ensemble, ils nouent un lien de type Bonnie and Clyde fondé sur le besoin mutuel, l’ambition et une intense dépendance l’un envers l’autre. Alors qu’ils plongent plus profondément dans une vie de crime, leur survie dépend en fin de compte de leur capacité à se faire réellement confiance. Selon Rockstar, ils « se retrouvent du côté le plus sombre de l’endroit le plus ensoleillé d’Amérique », ce qui ressemble incontestablement aux bases d’un jeu GTA.
Le jeu original Grand Theft Auto: Vice City est sorti en 2002 sur PlayStation 2 et se déroulait en 1986 dans une ambiance inspirée de Miami Vice. Mais ce nouveau volet actualise l’époque. Son cadre contemporain laisse toujours de la place aux néons, aux voitures de sport et aux plages de sable bondées, mais des fans aux yeux de lynx ont pu établir des comparaisons entre les lieux des bandes-annonces et ceux du jeu original. Cela implique un retour à l’Ocean View Hotel, une planque du jeu PS2, et probablement un refuge pour nos apprentis gangsters cette fois-ci encore. Ailleurs, une série de « cartes postales » publiées par le développeur Rockstar Games montre des zones situées au-delà de Vice City. Les Leonida Keys, un chapelet d’îles s’étendant dans l’océan, ont un parallèle évident dans le monde réel avec les Keys de Floride.
Vous y trouverez également : • Mount Kalaga National Park : verdoyant et luxuriant. • Port Gellhorn : motels bon marché, attractions fermées et centres commerciaux en plein air déserts. • Ambrosia : une ville industrielle et agricole. • Grassrivers : les Everglades, espérons-le avec des hydroglisseurs et des alligators.
Le monde de GTA 6 sera en libre circulation, avec la possibilité de monter dans une voiture et de visiter ces monuments. Et en parlant de voitures, les bandes-annonces regorgent de cabriolets et de « muscle cars », incarnant à chaque centimètre le rêve américain. On peut s’attendre à bien d’autres véhicules, certains liés à des activités secondaires comme les motos tout-terrain et les jet-skis, tandis qu’un hydravion survole l’une des scènes de cartes postales. Bien sûr, vous retrouverez les stations de radio emblématiques de la série à écouter en conduisant, probablement avec une vaste bande originale sous licence et, espérons-le, des animateurs exubérants, même si nous n’entendrons pas Lazlow Jones, ce dernier ayant quitté le développeur Rockstar Games.
L’un des plus grands changements attendus dans GTA 6 est une refonte du système de niveau de recherche (les étoiles de police). Auparavant, le niveau de recherche allait de zéro à cinq étoiles, les niveaux les plus élevés provoquant une réponse policière croissante face à vos agissements, allant jusqu’à l’utilisation de chars d’assaut et d’armes automatiques. Pour perdre des étoiles et calmer le jeu, vous pouviez vous cacher, changer d’apparence ou même monter dans un train. Dans GTA 6, on peut s’attendre à une sixième étoile et à une police beaucoup plus réactive à vos actions. En septembre 2022, alors qu’on n’a encore rien vu de GTA 6 , des dizaines et des dizaines de clips montrant le jeu, alors en plein développement, inondent la toile . Rockstar Games vient tout juste de subir l’un des plus gros hacks de l’histoire. Arion Kurtaj, 17 ans à l’époque, a utilisé trois bouts de ficelle pour s’en prendre au studio , parvenant à subtiliser 90 clips, soit près d’une heure de gameplay.

Sponsorisé Seulement jusqu’au 30 Novembre ! Atteint d’un autisme sévère, Arion Kurtaj n’a pas pu être jugé de manière classique. En 2023, la justice britannique a seulement organisé un « procès des faits », où le jury a établi qu’il avait bien commis les attaques. Jugeant ses talents de hacker dangereux pour le public, le tribunal l’a placé en décembre 2023 dans un hôpital sécurisé pour une durée indéterminée. On pensait cette affaire définitivement close, mais la BBC rapporte ce lundi 16 novembre qu’Arion Kurtaj vient de plaider coupable.
GTA 6 // Source : Rockstar Games Le jeune hacker de GTA reconnaît tous les faits qui lui sont reprochés Membre du gang de hacking Lapsus$ , Arion Kurtaj était déjà en liberté provisoire pour d’autres piratages, dont celui de Nvidia, et placé sous protection policière face à des hackers rivaux quand il s’en est pris à GTA 6 . Pour réussir son méfait, il n’a même pas eu besoin d’un ordinateur (la police lui avait confisqué le sien). Dans sa chambre d’hôtel, il a utilisé une clé Fire TV d’Amazon, branchée sur le téléviseur de l’hôtel et associée à un clavier et à une souris Bluetooth.
Il a ensuite menacé Rockstar Games, en s’immisçant dans sa messagerie Slack interne : « Si Rockstar ne me contacte pas sur Telegram dans les 24 heures, je commencerai à divulguer le code source. » Le studio n’a pas cédé. Arion Kurtaj a alors publié les clips et une partie du code source sur un forum, sous le pseudo TeaPotUberHacker. On y découvrait notamment que l’un des personnages jouables serait une femme, Lucia. À l’époque, on savait juste que le jeu était en cours de développement. Aucune image ni vidéo officielle n’avait été partagée (la première bande-annonce date de décembre 2023, soit plus d’un an après). Rockstar a chiffré à 5 millions de dollars (environ 4,3 millions d’euros) le coût de l’attaque, sans compter des milliers d’heures de travail de ses équipes.
Fin 2025, une évaluation médicale de routine a jugé Arion Kurtaj apte à suivre un procès classique. Devant la Crown Court de Woolwich, à Londres, il a plaidé coupable de tous les chefs d’accusation qui le visaient, y compris ses attaques sur d’autres grosses entreprises (Revolut, Uber, les opérateurs britanniques BT et EE) ainsi que des agressions sur des membres du personnel pendant sa détention, dont plusieurs morsures. Sa peine sera prononcée le 23 novembre, devant le même tribunal.

Une vraie Ferrari Testarossa transformée en voiture de GTA 6 est à vendre plus d’un million d’euros
articles.chapeau: Une Ferrari Testarossa métamorphosée en GTA 6 Grotti Cheetah s’affiche à 1 M£ chez Selfridges ; entre objet de culte pop et possible casse-tête juridique.
articles.txt:
© X / GTA6 GFX À Londres, une Ferrari Testarossa déguisée en GTA 6 Grotti Cheetah est affichée à plus d’un million d’euros. Entre rêve de gamer, spéculation folle et gêne possible chez Ferrari, l’affaire intrigue.
Une vraie Ferrari Testarossa grimée en supercar de GTA 6 Grotti Cheetah , posée en vitrine d’un grand magasin londonien et affichée plus d’un million d’euros : on pourrait croire à une blague de gamer. Pourtant, cette voiture existe, repose sur un authentique châssis Ferrari et attend un acheteur fortuné chez Selfridges, à Londres.
Derrière cette opération très pop‑culture, on retrouve Rockstar Games, qui prépare la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI , et le préparateur californien West Coast Customs. Ensemble, ils ont transformé une vraie Testarossa en Cheetah "réelle", pièce de promo devenue objet de collection potentiel. De quoi faire rêver les fans… et mettre les avocats de Ferrari en alerte.
Dans l’univers de GTA, la marque fictive Grotti joue clairement le rôle de Ferrari, et la Cheetah reprend les lignes d’une Testarossa à moteur central arrière, grandes ouïes latérales comprises. Pour ce show-car, la base serait une Testarossa ou une 512 TR réelle : châssis, mécanique et proportions viennent de Maranello, mais toute la carrosserie a été redessinée pour coller au modèle virtuel.
Les boucliers, prises d’air et feux ont été retravaillés, les badges au cheval cabré ont disparu au profit d’écussons fantaisie sur fond jaune, qui rappellent évidemment le blason d’origine sans l’utiliser. La livrée joue à fond la carte Vice City, avec un dégradé bleu‑rose très Miami. Et dans le jeu, la ’95 Grotti Cheetah est annoncée comme l’une des stars de l’Ultimate Edition de GTA 6, ce qui renforce encore le côté "voiture culte" de ce prototype.
Rockstar Games a mandaté West Coast Customs pour recréer plusieurs voitures de GTA 6 en taille réelle. Six autos auraient été construites à partir de supercars bien connues, dont cette Cheetah basée sur une Ferrari, mais aussi des modèles inspirés de Lamborghini Huracán, McLaren Senna ou Corvette C8. La Cheetah a d’abord paradé dans les rues de Miami avant de rejoindre le corner GTA 6 de Selfridges, sur Oxford Street.
Chez Selfridges, cette Grotti Cheetah est exposée comme la pièce maîtresse d’un pop‑up entièrement dédié à GTA 6, ouvert sur une période limitée. Elle est proposée à 1 000 000 £, soit autour de 1,3 million d’euros, via le service Personal Shopping du grand magasin. Une somme qui dépasse de très loin la cote d’une Testarossa de collection , déjà largement au‑delà des 100 000 € pour un bel exemplaire.
Icône des années 80, la Ferrari Testarossa a inspiré la Grotti Cheetah de GTA, aujourd’hui elle est recréée en vrai et proposée à plus d’un million d’euros.
Ferrari a la réputation de surveiller de très près l’usage de ses voitures et de son image. Le constructeur italien a déjà demandé à des propriétaires de retirer des modifications jugées nuisibles pour la marque, y compris sur des autos engagées dans des événements privés comme le Gumball. Ici, la base reste une Ferrari clairement identifiable, même si le nom et les logos ont disparu, et la voiture sert d’outil marketing très visible.
Côté passionnés, les réactions se divisent : certains voient dans cette Cheetah réelle un graal pour fans de GTA 6, entre art automobile et objet de musée. D’autres parlent de "sacrilège", estimant qu’une Testarossa aurait été "sacrifiée" pour un projet promo, surtout à un tarif qui permettrait d’acheter plusieurs Ferrari d’origine. Reste à savoir si un collectionneur misera sur cette prime à la culture jeu vidéo… et si Ferrari restera silencieux.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Faites de la place sur votre console, vu son poids de téléchargement gigantesque - STUFF Magazine
articles.chapeau: Il reste encore quelques jours avant que Grand Theft Auto 6 ne soit mis en vente, et vous allez probablement avoir besoin de ce temps pour faire de la place sur le disque dur de votre console de jeux. articles.txt:
Il reste encore quelques jours avant que Grand Theft Auto 6 ne soit mis en vente, et vous allez probablement avoir besoin de ce temps pour faire de la place sur le disque dur de votre console de jeux.
Avec les précommandes désormais disponibles, nous sommes sur le point de voir les joueurs capables de pré-télécharger le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de tous les temps. Télécharger le blockbuster de Rockstar en arrière-plan garantira que GTA 6 soit disponible pour être joué dès qu’il sera disponible le 19 novembre.
Dans une publication sur le PlayStation Blog, Sony a déclaré que les joueurs sur PS5 auront besoin d’un minimum de 212 Go d’espace de stockage disponible sur leur console afin de terminer le téléchargement. Rockstar affirme que les joueurs auront besoin de “jusqu’à” 212 Go selon leur appareil, donc la version Xbox ne dépassera pas cela.
Les modèles PS5 Slim ultérieurs disposent d’environ 830 Go d’espace de stockage utilisable sur le disque de 1 To, tandis que le stockage utilisable de la Xbox Series X dépasse légèrement 800 Go. Quoi qu’il en soit, cela représente environ un quart de la capacité. La diffusion en streaming du jeu via un service comme Xbox Cloud Gaming ne sera pas disponible initialement ni peut-être jamais, et il n’y a pas de disques physiques. Donc trouver ou créer l’espace pour un téléchargement est la seule solution.
Pour ceux qui manquent actuellement de tout cet espace, il pourrait s’agir de supprimer des jeux et d’autres fichiers téléchargés, ou de les déplacer vers un stockage USB étendu. Vous ne pouvez pas lancer de jeux depuis un stockage USB étendu sur PS5, mais vous pouvez améliorer le stockage en installant un disque SSD compatible M.2, ce qui est un processus plus laborieux. Pour les utilisateurs de Xbox Series X/S, le tableau est un peu plus lumineux, les joueurs pouvant lancer tous les jeux de la génération Xbox directement depuis les cartes d’extension de stockage officielles qui se branchent à l’arrière de la console.

articles.txt:
À deux jours de la sortie de GTA 6, des acheteurs sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S affirment avoir reçu leur édition en boîte sans code de téléchargement. Si l’absence de disque est prévue par Rockstar, celle du code est problématique car elle empêche de précharger le jeu et d’y accéder à sa sortie, le 19 novembre 2026.
Commercialisée à 79,99 €, l’édition boîte est disponible depuis le 12 novembre. Elle permet le préchargement du jeu afin d’étre opération le jour J. Malheureusement tout ne se passe pas comme prévu. Des retours sont à ‘l’origine de photos montrant une bande grise sans code visible à l’endroit prévu. D’autres disent étre dans la même situation. Si certains ont obtenu un exemplaire de remplacement, ce n’est pas le cas de toutes les victimes. Certaines rapportent des difficultés à faire traiter leur réclamation.
Pour le moment nous ne savons pas combien d’exemplaires sont concernés.
Face aux différents problèmes évoqués voici les démarches à faire selon deux cas de figures.
Si le code est absent, conservez la boîte, photographiez son contenu et gardez votre preuve d’achat. Rockstar renvoie les clients qui n’ont pas commandé sur sa boutique vers leur revendeur pour les questions d’achat, de livraison et de remboursement. C’est donc le premier interlocuteur à contacter pour demander un échange.
Si le code est présent mais refusé, Rockstar oriente les joueurs vers le support PlayStation ou Xbox. Attention sur PS5, un code acheté à l’étranger peut aussi être incompatible avec la région du compte.

articles.txt:
La sortie de GTA 6 se compte désormais en heures et la communication autour d’elle bat son plein, de moult manières. Parmi les exemples, l’équipe de basket américaine du Heat de Miami se renommera et portera une tunique aux couleurs du titre de Rockstar, le temps d’un match. Mais qui dit basket dit aussi NBA 2K27 . Et vu que Take-Two possède les deux franchises, pourquoi ne pas profiter de l’une pour promouvoir l’autre ? C’est ce qu’il va bientôt se passer avec une collaboration interne visant surtout à mettre en avant le mastodonte de Rockstar au sein de la simulation sportive de 2K Games.
Une auto-promo en 4K À l’occasion de cette collaboration, plusieurs choses sont à noter. La principale est que la simulation de basket va temporairement proposer une version spéciale portée visuellement par le triple All-Star floridien Bam Adebayo. Intitulée NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition , elle sera disponible uniquement en numérique du 27 novembre 2026 au 15 janvier 2027, au prix de 39,99 € . Ensuite, toute la Saison 3 sera placée sous le signe de GTA 6 , avec notamment des cosmétiques et éléments de décor que l’on peut découvrir dans le trailer dédié.
La Saison 3: Vice City Takeover s’invitera donc déjà dans La Ville au niveau des environnements, modifiant les terrains et ajoutant des néons, la présence de voitures tirées de GTA et même celle d’une statue de Macca l’alligator. Et selon votre progression dans la saison, vous pourrez arborer des skins spéciaux comme un ensemble Los Santos évidemment inspiré des couleurs des Los Angeles Lakers.
Des événements limités seront également proposés, tout comme la tenue Nike x Cactus Jack Miami Heat que portera l’équipe de NBA le 18 novembre contre les Bucks de Milwaukee . Parmi les autres nouveautés de la saison 3, on retrouvera de nouveaux builds GOAT, des cartes Vice City dans MyTeam et du contenu Pro Pass et Hall of Fame Pass comportant notamment des items inspirés de Rockstar ainsi que de Burger Shot et Cluckin’ Bell, les chaînes de fast-food de l’univers de GTA.
La collaboration ne s’arrête pas là puisque l’abonnement GTA+ entre en scène. Les membres pourront jouer gratuitement à l’édition standard de NBA 2K27 , là aussi du 27 novembre au 15 janvier . On voit mal une personne aimant la licence GTA au point de payer l’abonnement, et ne pas exclusivement poncer le prochain jusqu’à la fin d’année minimum, mais pourquoi pas. Parallèlement, du 17 décembre au 31 mars 2027, le pack GTA + NBA 2K27 sera téléchargeable et apportera des tenues et des boosts pour Ma Carrière.

articles.t: Newzoo: GTA 6 pre-orders are archetypal console players but overwhelmingly male; game will "grow the market rather than simply redistribute it"
articles.chapeau: "[Players] don’t just buy GTA 6, they become potential customers for a much broader catalogue of games," says Newzoo's director of market intelligence
articles.txt:
GTA 6 preorders are from archetypal, high-spending console gamers, overwhelmingly male, and most have a history of spending on the franchise, according to data from Newzoo shared exclusively with GamesIndustry.biz ahead of the game's final release on Thursday.
While the majority were regular game buyers, 16% of them hadn't purchased a full-price game in the last 12 months - suggesting the title is bringing back lapsed players - and the firm projected that while the launch would temporarily draw playtime and spending away from other titles, it would ultimately drive additional demand. .
The news follows the firm's previous forecast that the title will drive a 17.5% increase in console full-game spending , and single-handedly prevent the console market from decreasing year-over-year.
Addressing the widely-held concerns that the game will damage other releases – which it said had lead to only two AAA releases between October 8 and November 18, compared to ten in 2025 and eight in 2024 – Director of Market Intelligence Emmanuel Rosier anticipated a short-term impact that would be followed by additional demand. "Some players are likely to stretch their gaming budgets and buy it on top of what they’d normally spend in a year," he said.
52% of people who pre-ordered GTA 6 have spent money on GTA 5 or GTA Online since 2018, the firm said. Across all people who pre-ordered, at least 37% have spent on GTA Online and 31% on the GTA V full game, with around one in six having done both - Rosier classified those figures as a minimum, as the firm does not have data going back as far as the GTA 5 launch in 2013.
The buyer profile closely matches conventional buyers of premium games, the firm said. 56% of those pre-ordering are under 35, compared with 55% of all premium game buyers, and 22% are 45 or older, compared with 23%. There was a sharp difference in gender, though: while women made up 27% of all premium game buyers during the pre-order period, only 15% of the people pre-ordering GTA 6 were women.
This exceeds even the franchise's previous history of a male-dominated audience; Newzoo data shows women accounting for 22% of GTA 5 game buyers since 2018. The difference was most pronounced among younger demographics, while women made up 21% of pre-orders in the 45-54 demographic. Rosier said that the firm would "expect launch buyers to be a broader group," given that "players who pre-order tend to be the most committed fans."
Newzoo found that most GTA 6 pre-order customers regularly buy premium games, with 84% purchasing at least one other premium title in the 12 months before GTA 6 pre-orders opened on June 24 . The typical person pre-ordering the game spent $129 across three other premium games, and a quarter spent more than $290, not including any in-game spending.
The remaining 16% of those pre-ordering the game had not purchased a full game in the preceding 12 months, and for 3% of them the firm had no evidence of a premium purchase at all, indicating no games had been purchased since at least 2018. "For those players, GTA 6 looks like genuinely new spending," said Rosier, "because it’s bringing lapsed and occasional buyers back."
The firm expected that the game's launch will "encourage some players to upgrade to the current console generation" – while noting that 85% of current GTA 5 players have already done so – and said this would expand the audience for other titles, as its data indicated that current-generation console players typically play a much wider range of games than those using previous hardware.
"We expect that effect to build gradually," said Rosier. "GTA 6 launches late in the year, so much of the benefit is likely to come in 2027 rather than 2026. Even after accounting for the pressure on competing titles, our view is that the net effect will be positive. GTA 6 will grow the market rather than simply redistribute it."
The firm said that GTA 6's console-only launch would limit its reach, pointing to its previous data suggesting that console would only represent 22% of global games revenue in 2026.
"While GTA 6 is undoubtedly one of the most important releases of the decade, its initial impact will be concentrated in Western console," said Rosier. "That’s still a big market, which we forecast will be worth $36.3 billion in 2026, but it’s only part of the industry. The longer-term global story will depend on what happens next, particularly on PC and online."

Teen who hacked Rockstar and leaked GTA 6 pleads guilty, right before game launch
articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking GTA 6 footage. His sentencing will decide between a long-term prison term and another hospital order.
articles.txt:
SIGN IN Edition IN IN US Download App Follow Us On: News Technology News Teen who hacked Rockstar & leaked GTA 6 pleads guilty, right before game launch Teen who hacked Rockstar and leaked GTA 6 pleads guilty, right before game launch As millions of gamers eagerly count down the days to play GTA 6, the hacker who gave the world its first illegal look at the game is now just counting down the days to his prison sentence. Advertisement The teen who hacked GTA 6 with a TV stick just pleaded guilty. By: Krishna Goswami New Delhi , Nov 17, 2026 12:25 IST Last Updated Nov 17, 2026 12:25 IST Published by Krishna Goswami Nov 17, 2026 12:25 IST A 21-year-old hacker, Arion Kurtaj, has pleaded guilty to a string of online crimes, including the massive 2022 hack of Rockstar Games that led to the leak of Grand Theft Auto 6. Kurtaj, a key member of the Lapsus$ hacking gang, admitted to his crimes at the Woolwich Crown Court in London on Monday, November 16, 2026.
The guilty plea comes after a highly unusual legal journey. In December 2023, Kurtaj was given an indefinite secure hospital order because doctors believed his severe autism made him unfit to stand a traditional trial.
However, a routine assessment in late 2025 found him fit to face a criminal trial, and he was moved to a standard prison in January 2026. How the GTA 6 hack happened
The way Kurtaj hacked Rockstar Games is quite surprising. In 2022, he was staying at a Travelodge hotel in Bicester under police protection. He was already on bail for other hacking offences, and his laptop had been confiscated by the police.
Despite having no computer, Kurtaj managed to breach Rockstar's systems using just an Amazon Fire Stick plugged into his hotel room TV, a smartphone, a Bluetooth keyboard, and a mouse.
He stole 90 video clips showing nearly 60 minutes of unfinished GTA 6 gameplay. He then accessed the company's internal Slack messages and threatened to release the game's source code if Rockstar did not contact him on Telegram within 24 hours. When the company refused, he posted the clips on a forum under the username "TeaPotUberHacker".
The leak revealed that GTA 6 would feature its first female playable character, Lucia, a secret Rockstar was closely guarding for marketing purposes. The company stated that recovering from the hack cost them around $5 million and thousands of hours of staff time. Millions in damages and violent behavior
Rockstar Games was not his only victim. Kurtaj also pleaded guilty to hacking Uber , Revolut, and the UK telecom company BT/EE. During the Uber hack, he used social engineering to access internal systems and posted an explicit image of a penis to force the company to pay a ransom.
The court also heard that Kurtaj and the Lapsus$ gang targeted individual cryptocurrency investors, stealing at least $300,000.
His bad behavior continued in custody. Kurtaj pleaded guilty to physically assaulting workers and biting staff multiple times. After being moved to a normal prison, he was caught with a smuggled mobile phone. He used it to send a taunting text message to the police and post updates on Snapchat, which tipped off reporters that he was no longer in the secure hospital. What happens next
Kurtaj stood in the dock on Monday wearing a suit and a buttoned-up white shirt with no tie. He blinked frequently and showed no visible emotion as he confirmed his name and pleaded guilty to all charges, including fraud and unauthorized computer access.
He is scheduled to be sentenced on November 23, 2026. The judge will decide whether he gets a long-term prison sentence or if his mental health history requires him to be sent back under another hospital order.
Earlier this year, another teenage member of the Lapsus$ gang, Thalha Jubair, was sentenced to five and a half years in prison for continuing his cybercrimes with another hacking group called Scattered Spider. - Ends Also Read | GTA 6 just smashed Internet download records, days before it even launches Also Read | Ahead of GTA 6 launch, how Grand Theft Auto became a part of India's gaming DNA Also Read | Not just PS5, Microsoft says GTA 6 will be playable on this 13 year old Xbox

articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj, the Lapsus$ hacker behind the 2022 leak of GTA 6 footage, has pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games. The 21-year-old from Oxford entered his plea at Woolwich Crown Court in London on Monday, November 16, three days before Rockstar releases the game on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Kurtaj also admitted to attacks on BT/EE, Revolut and Uber, which he carried out at the ages of 16 and 17. He further pleaded guilty to assaulting workers while in custody, including several biting incidents. He will be sentenced at the same court on November 23.
Psychiatrists assessed Kurtaj as unfit to stand trial in 2023 because of his autism. A jury at Southwark Crown Court was asked only to decide whether he had committed the acts, and in August 2023 it found he carried out 12 offenses, including three counts of blackmail, two of fraud, and six under the Computer Misuse Act. A mental health assessment presented at his sentencing found he still intended to return to cybercrime as soon as possible.
Kurtaj received a restricted hospital order for an unlimited period in December 2023, which meant he would stay in a secure hospital until doctors judged him no longer a danger. Doctors found him fit to stand trial after a routine assessment in January 2026, and he moved to an ordinary prison to await a fresh hearing. His guilty pleas mean that hearing will not go to trial.
Kurtaj breached Rockstar in September 2022 while on bail for earlier hacks and staying in a Travelodge hotel under police protection. He used an Amazon Fire TV Stick, a smartphone, a keyboard, and a mouse to get in. He then posted in the studio's internal Slack, writing, "I am not a Rockstar employee, I am an attacker," and threatened to start releasing the game's source code unless Rockstar contacted him on Telegram within 24 hours.
Rockstar refused to cooperate. Ninety clips containing nearly 60 minutes of footage from a pre-release build then appeared on a GTA fan forum, more than a year before Rockstar released its first official trailer in December 2023. The clips revealed details, including the game's playable female protagonist, Lucia . Rockstar later told the court the breach cost it $5 million and thousands of hours of staff time.
Prosecutors cast Kurtaj as a leading figure in Lapsus$, a teen-run extortion group that also breached Nvidia , Samsung , and Microsoft in 2021 and 2022. The prosecution estimated damage of around £10 million from his other hacking activities, and his Revolut breach exposed the details of thousands of customers.
A second Lapsus$ member, who was 17 at the time and cannot be named for legal reasons, received a youth rehabilitation order in December 2023 for fraud, Computer Misuse Act and blackmail offenses. GTA 6 launches on November 19 after two delays, first from 2025 and then from May 26, 2026. The standard edition costs $79.99.

articles.t: PSA: Some GTA 6 Physical Copies Don't Include a Download Code, Some Codes Already Used
articles.chapeau: New fear unlocked: it looks like some Grand Theft Auto 6 boxes don’t include a download code; others claim their codes have already been used
articles.txt:
20 photos Photo: Rockstar GTA 6 is just around the corner , as the game will unlock on November 19, so those who haven’t purchased the game already rush to stores, digital or physical, to get it. The pre-order bonus and the ability to pre-download the game to be able to play it on day one are the most obvious benefits of wanting to do this early. But unfortunately for some of those who actually wanted to hold GTA 6 in their hand, the physical copies of the game - at least some of them - come with horrendous news. There’s no code inside, or the code printed on the inside has already been used.
As awful as that might sound, it’s important to remember that this doesn’t happen to everybody. However, there are several reports on social media where people went to retail stores, paid for their copy of GTA 6, only to discover that the code was missing. Others discovered a similar problem hours later when they attempted to download the game files: the code was invalid.
Photo: Rockstar Games Rockstar offers GTA 6 in two versions . You can get the game from a digital store, such as the PlayStation Store, where you buy it directly and can immediately start the download.
The second option is the old-fashioned way, where you get a physical copy of the game. We’ve waited more than a decade for this thing, so I can totally understand why so many people want to actually hold GTA 6 in their hands. But it’s 2026, so we buy boxes with codes in them.
The physical copy of GTA 6 does not include a disc, but a small label with a download code printed on it. This means that you’ll still end up in front of your PlayStation, entering a code, and downloading the game just like those people who bought it online.
The problem is that these codes are either missing or invalid.
Photo: Rockstar Games A discussion thread on reddit starts with an awful statement and an accompanying picture. “No code in Xbox box,” the poster explains. They later explained that they reached out to Rockstar support to no avail.
“I had been told by GameStop to contact Rockstar as it was a manufacturing defect. After back and forth with both companies' support agents, I finally got some sort of update from GameStop claiming they will escalate my issue and I’ll have to wait 24-48 hours for a response,” they explained.
Others claim a similar thing happened to them despite buying the game directly from Rockstar. “I got mine from Rockstar directly, and 1000% learned my lesson. Never again,” they explain.
Photo: Rockstar Games Someone else says they also received an empty physical copy of GTA 6 after paying for the box at Target. “I heard this was happening, so I opened it in my car, and it was blank.”
They went back into the store, talked to the manager, and despite the staff originally refusing to replace the empty box, another customer came with a similar problem. Eventually, the manager decided to replace the physical box and “make all stores aware.”
While so many people seem to believe that the code is scratchable, it is not. Also, you’d better be careful with scratching that film because you could end up damaging it.
Some GTA 6 buyers claim they did get a code, but they were told it had already been used when trying to download the game. This seems to suggest that someone somehow managed to extract the code without opening the case.
Photo: Rockstar Games The most obvious approach would be a way to read the code through the case, and some people have tried to test whether it’s possible to see the code using a flashlight directly on the box. This method did not work, so maybe others have found a different method, or the invalid codes are just a problem on Rockstar’s side.
If you, too, are coming across a missing code, the best approach is to contact the store where you bought the game. Amazon has already refunded some people, while others are reporting mixed results with Target, Best Buy, and GameStop. If you buy a GTA 6 physical copy, the best thing you can do is to open it right after paying for it, maybe in front of the manager. 7 photos Photo: The Weather Channel/Rockstar GTA 6 will finally become playable in a couple of days, and man, what a long wait it has been. But the closer we get to the grand November 19 date, the more excited everybody gets, and Rockstar has just found the perfect way to fuel this frenzy. The company teamed up with The Weather Channel to reveal - what else, since it’s The Weather Channel? - the weather system in GTA 6. The dynamic weather system, to be more precise, as the conditions will change in what is likely to be an unpredictable way.
Why? Because Leonida, the fictional world where GTA 6 takes place, is inspired by Florida. And Rockstar Games describes Florida as “a landscape with one of the most unpredictable weather systems in the US.” So it’s safe to assume the same thing will happen in GTA 6.
The new screenshots reveal how the weather changes across Leonida, and Rockstar says we’ll deal with conditions that “feel more localized, persistent, and above all, dynamic.”
This means that if it’s raining in one part of the city, it might be sunny in another part. And more importantly, it won’t be raining all the time in the same place, as the weather system was supposed from the very beginning to be dynamic. It’s as realistic as it gets, with the screenshots revealing heavy rain that makes driving more challenging.
Photo: The Weather Channel/Rockstar That’s why “local authorities have installed reflectors in some of the roads to help driving,” The Weather Channel explained in a post on X. The company also suggests that gamers “better get their headlights fixed at Coastal Auto Care,” so there’s a chance the headlights of your vehicle will also play a critical role in visibility on the road.
Pelican Valley will also be transformed completely after a storm, with murky water now making the terrain more difficult. The sea fog will make the view quite fascinating close to South Ocean Beach Hotel, while low-lying mist in Gambit Bay, primarily caused by high humidity, is also making hunting more challenging.
Rain and wind will also influence gameplay and NPCs, and The Weather Channel specifically teases an impact on the commute from key Lento, suggesting that driving conditions might be more difficult when such conditions occur.
Photo: The Weather Channel/Rockstar The dynamic weather system will also affect how NPCs behave and what they do in the game. For example, the screenshot revealing the tropical storms that can be observed from Rusty Anchor shows NPCs sitting on the dock, with all boats right on the shoreline for obvious reasons.
Owen Shepherd, VP of Art: Light and Rendering, Rockstar Games, explains in The Weather Channel’s post that Florida residents will be familiar with the climate in Leonida pretty much because the GTA 6 world was designed specifically to reflect modern-day Florida.

articles.t: Kemi Badenoch Says GTA 6 Playtime Worries Her More Than Its Content

articles.txt:
Kemi Badenoch says the time children spend playing GTA 6 concerns her more than the game’s content, putting screen-time habits at the centre of her remarks ahead of its November 19 launch. As reported by IGN , she said she would worry more about how long people spend playing a game than about the game itself. The comments came while she was setting out Conservative education policy aimed at reducing children’s screen time at school.
Badenoch’s comparison was specific: a child spending all day playing GTA 6 in their bedroom would concern her more than one playing for half an hour before going outside. She also acknowledged concerns about Grand Theft Auto’s content and said she had not played it. That makes these comments a statement about her priorities around children’s screen use, rather than an assessment based on playing the series.
The education proposal gives that position a concrete policy context. Badenoch announced that funding would be diverted from the UK government’s school laptop budget to purchase millions of physical textbooks. Her gaming remarks therefore sit alongside a proposed change in classroom resources, connecting the discussion about leisure time with a broader push to reduce children’s exposure to screens at school.
There is an important distinction between the two questions raised here: how long a child plays, and whether a game’s content is appropriate for them. GTA 6 is rated for adults only, according to IGN’s report. The ESRB content description cited in that reporting warns of blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, strong sexual content, and the use of drugs and alcohol. A shorter session does not change those content warnings.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, bringing Badenoch’s comments into the immediate run-up to release.

articles.t: GTA 6 Hacker Arion Kurtaj Pleads Guilty to 2022 Rockstar Hack - Shane the Gamer
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 hacker Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to the 2022 Rockstar hack. He also admitted Uber, Revolut, and BT/EE attacks and faces sentencing on 23 November.
articles.txt:
Arion Kurtaj, the hacker who leaked nearly an hour of unfinished Grand Theft Auto 6 ( GTA 6 ) footage in 2022, pleaded guilty on 16 November to breaching Rockstar Games, three days before the game’s 19 November launch. The 21-year-old from Oxfordshire also admitted attacks on Uber, Revolut, and BT/EE that he carried out at 16 and 17 as a member of the Lapsus$ hacking group.
The pleas, entered at Woolwich Crown Court in London, give Kurtaj his first criminal conviction over the hack. He had been held in a secure hospital under an indefinite order since December 2023, after doctors judged his autism too severe for a conventional trial, but a later assessment found him fit to stand trial and he was moved to an ordinary prison in January.
According to the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS), Kurtaj admitted three counts of an unauthorised act to impair the operation of a computer, one count of fraud, one count of securing unauthorised access to computer material with intent, and one count of possessing a mobile phone in prison. The hacking offences date from August 2021 to September 2022.
At Uber, Kurtaj sent an explicit image to staff while pressing the company for a ransom, took confidential records, and deleted internal files, causing more than US$2.8 million (£2.1 million) in damage. His breach of Revolut exposed details belonging to thousands of customers. The BT/EE intrusion led to a rise in unauthorised SIM swaps, a scam where criminals trick a phone provider into moving a victim’s number onto a new SIM card, which gives the criminals that person’s calls and texts and a way into their bank and social media accounts.
Reporting from the hearing, the BBC said Kurtaj also pleaded guilty to assaulting staff while in custody, including several biting incidents. Prosecutors cast him as a leading figure in Lapsus$ and told the court the group used data stolen from its corporate targets to go after cryptocurrency investors, taking at least US$300,000 from individuals. Kurtaj’s attacks on the companies are estimated to have caused around £10 million in damage.
Kurtaj breached Rockstar in September 2022, after he had already been charged over the 2021 BT/EE breach and while on bail over earlier hacks, including one on Nvidia. Police had placed him in a Travelodge in Bicester to protect him from rival hackers who had threatened him over his Bitcoin, and his computer had been confiscated. He kept going anyway, using an Amazon Fire TV Stick plugged into the hotel room’s television, a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, and a mobile phone. That is the conduct the CPS highlighted after the plea, with specialist prosecutor Robert Hutchinson saying Kurtaj kept targeting organisations after being charged, which showed “a persistent disregard for the harm he was causing and the law”.
Prosecutors told his 2023 trial that he got into Rockstar’s systems by posing as a staff member who had lost a password, moving on to a contractor’s account when a former employee’s login failed. Once inside, he took internal data that included 90 clips with nearly an hour of footage from the unfinished GTA 6, then posted on Rockstar’s internal Slack giving the studio 24 hours to contact him on Telegram before he started releasing its source code.
Rockstar refused to cooperate, so Kurtaj posted the clips and source code on a forum under the username TeaPotUberHacker. The studio had not yet released the game’s first trailer.
Rockstar has said the breach cost US$5 million (£3.79 million) to recover from, plus thousands of hours of staff time. The studio also said the leak was the first time the public learned that one of GTA 6’s playable characters was a woman, a secret it had been guarding closely for its marketing. That character is Lucia, who shares the lead with Jason and is the first playable female character in the series’ 3D games. The US$5 million covered the clean-up, but it couldn’t give Rockstar a second chance at introducing her, since players first saw Lucia in stolen, unfinished clips instead of a trailer the studio controlled.
Rockstar tightened security after the breach, including a ban on developers working from home, but GTA 6 has leaked again this year. Gameplay videos began surfacing over the summer in a run of leaks Rockstar called “heartbreaking”, and a video released in October included story spoilers. articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj did not plead guilty. Found to have done the acts, unfit for trial, hospital order. Rockstar says the GTA 6 hack cost $5M.
articles.txt:
Photo: McPhail, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons A headline making the rounds today says Rockstar Games hacker Arion Kurtaj “pleads guilty” over a $5 million GTA 6 hack. The reporting we can verify tells a different story. Kurtaj was found to have carried out the acts, but he was deemed unfit to stand trial, and the jury was never asked to decide his criminal intent. Beinsure is among the outlets that framed the story as a plea, and that framing is the first thing worth correcting.
The distinction matters more than it looks. With GTA 6 gameplay clips circulating again just days before launch , the 2022 Rockstar intrusion has become the reference case for how a pre-release leak happens and what it costs. Getting the legal status and the dollar figure right is the difference between useful analysis and recycled noise. This piece separates what is confirmed from what is not, then looks at what the case means for studios, publishers and security teams.
Here is the short version. In September 2022, an intruder pulled 90 clips of unreleased GTA 6 footage out of Rockstar’s systems. Kurtaj, then linked to the Lapsus$ group, was found responsible for 12 offenses at Southwark Crown Court. On 21 December 2023 he received an indefinite hospital order. Rockstar told the court the incident cost it $5 million and thousands of hours of recovery work. Nothing in the verified record shows a guilty plea, a prison sentence or a ransom payment of $5 million.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The confirmed record is specific. Arion Kurtaj was 18 at the time of the proceedings. The case was heard at Southwark Crown Court. The jury found that he had carried out the acts alleged, covering 12 offenses that included blackmail, fraud and offenses under the UK Computer Misuse Act. Because he was judged unfit to stand trial, the jury did not rule on whether he intended to commit crimes.
That is a very different outcome from a conviction. In a conventional trial, a jury weighs both the act and the mental state behind it. Here, the question put to jurors was narrower: did the defendant do these things? The answer was yes, and that finding is what the reporting means when it says he was “found responsible.” It is not a guilty verdict, and it is certainly not a guilty plea.
The practical result arrived on 21 December 2023, when Kurtaj received an indefinite hospital order. He was to remain in a secure hospital unless doctors determined that he was no longer a danger. There is no fixed release date attached to that kind of order. Release depends on a clinical judgment rather than a sentence length, which is why you will not find a “years served” figure in any reliable account of the case.
Two things appear to have collided. First, the word “responsible” in court coverage gets compressed by headline writers into “guilty.” Second, aggregator sites often repost a story with fresh timestamps, so a case from 2023 reads as breaking news in November 2026. Neither compression changes the facts. The available reporting does not support a guilty plea, and we are not going to repeat one.
This is not pedantry. A plea implies the defendant accepted responsibility with the capacity to do so. A finding of the acts without a trial implies the opposite: the court judged him unable to take part in the trial. Readers who see “pleads guilty” will assume a prison sentence, a negotiated deal and a closed file. The real situation involves a secure hospital, an open-ended order and a mental-health record that raised concerns about future behavior.
Three questions catch most errors. Did the defendant enter a plea, and if so, when? Did a jury or judge return a verdict on guilt, or only on the facts? And what disposal followed, such as a prison term, a suspended sentence or a hospital order? If a headline cannot answer all three, treat it as incomplete. Applied here, the answers are no plea in the verified record, a finding on the acts only, and an indefinite hospital order.
Reporting ties Kurtaj to Lapsus$, a hacking group whose targets included Rockstar Games, Uber and Nvidia. The group drew attention in 2022 because it went after large, well-resourced companies with methods that did not look like classic ransomware crews. It leaked data publicly, made demands and courted attention, which made its campaigns unusually visible to the press and to security researchers.

articles.t: GTA 6 Hacker Pleads Guilty Days Before Game's Release
articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak, pleaded guilty to multiple crimes just days before the game's release.
articles.txt:
A little game called Grand Theft Auto VI releases this week, and in a curious quirk of fate, this week also saw Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 leak of 90 clips containing nearly 60 minutes of footage from a pre-release build of the game, plead guilty to that attack and a bunch of others carried out around the same time.
Kurtaj was in his teens when the attacks were launched; most famously, he cracked Rockstar’s security using only an Amazon Fire Stick, a smart TV, and a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, doing so from a hotel room in which he was staying while on bail for other attacks. He was duly re-arrested in September 2022 and charged with multiple offences , including fraud, blackmail and computer misuse.
In August 2023, a jury found that Kurtaj had committed the alleged acts , but because doctors had deemed him unfit to stand trial due to his severe autism, the proceedings were limited to determining whether he had carried out the acts rather than whether he was criminally guilty. As the BBC’s Joe Tidy, who has followed the case closely, reported , Kurtaj was subsequently placed under an indefinite hospital order in December 2023, meaning he could remain in a secure hospital for the rest of his life unless authorities determined he was no longer a danger.
That situation changed in January this year after what Tidy described as a “routine assessment.” For reasons that remain unclear—after all, it’s not like someone magically becomes less autistic—Kurtaj was suddenly deemed fit to stand trial and sent to a normal prison to await his day in court. That day arrived this week, and Kurtaj pled guilty to carrying out the Rockstar hack and a string of others, along with several assaults at the aforementioned secure hospital, where he allegedly made a habit of biting workers who got too close to him.
The guilty pleas mean that there’ll be no drawn-out trial, and as of publication, the judgement in the case is yet to be made public, so details of the case are pretty minimal—the court listings for Woolwich Crown Court, where the hearing took place, say only that the hearing is finished. Still, the prosecution managed to outline some spicy details of the hacks, including the fact that “during his hack on Uber, Kurtaj posted a picture of a penis as part of his attempts to force the company to pay a ransom.” Delightful.
The guilty pleas mean that there’ll be no drawn-out trial, and Kurtaj is now scheduled to be sentenced on November 23. The court listings confirm that his case was heard at Woolwich Crown Court, while the Crown Prosecution Service has published a detailed account of his offenses. The prosecution also outlined some spicy details of the hacks, including the fact that “during his hack on Uber, Kurtaj posted a picture of a penis as part of his attempts to force the company to pay a ransom.” Delightful. Prosecutors said the Uber attack alone cost the company more than $2.8 million.
The Crown Prosecution Service says Kurtaj pleaded guilty to three counts of unauthorized acts impairing a computer’s operation, one count of unauthorized access with intent to commit a further offense, one count of fraud, and one offense involving possession of a mobile phone in prison. His earlier proceedings included blackmail charges, an offense carrying up to 14 years in prison under the Theft Act 1968, but the CPS has not listed a separate blackmail conviction among today’s guilty pleas. Fraud carries a maximum sentence of ten years under the Fraud Act 2006 . And then there are the assault offenses. The BBC reports that Kurtaj pleaded guilty to several assaults on staff while in custody, although the precise charges have not been established. Under UK law, common assault and actual bodily harm are distinct offenses , with different sentencing limits. How much time Kurtaj will actually serve remains to be determined, and the maximum sentences are not necessarily indicative of the punishment he will receive.
Anyway, the tl;dr here is that Kurtaj won’t be hacking anyone any time soon… although, with that said, he did manage to get hold of a mobile phone while in prison in March, from which he posted to Snapchat and, inexplicably, sent a mocking message to the police. For now, he’s back in custody to await sentencing on November 23. How long he’ll remain there—and whether he’ll end up back in a secure hospital—remains to be seen.

After things escalated, with people throwing bricks at his windows and attacking his mother’s car, police moved him to a hotel.

The 21-year-old responsible for hacking Rockstar Games and leaking in-development GTA 6 footage in 2022 has pleaded guilty to a number of offenses.
The GTA 6 leaker was initially sentenced to an indefinite stay at a hospital due to his severe autism, but was more recently deemed fit for trial and moved to a regular prison earlier this January. On Monday, at the Woolwich Crown Court in South East London, he pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and a number of other companies, including Uber and EE/BT, in cyber attacks estimated to have caused £10m in damages.
At the time of his Rockstar hack - when he was between the ages of 16 and 17 - the leaker was already under police protection at a Travelodge hotel to keep him from rival hackers he had allegedly stolen Bitcoin from. Somewhat surprisingly, he then managed to hack the multi-billion dollar game maker with nothing but an Amazon Fire Stick, the hotel room's TV and a bluetooth-connected keyboard and mouse.
As the BBC reports , he also managed to break into the developer's Slack channels, before threatening to release the GTA 6 source code if Rockstar failed to contact him within the day. The leaker has yet to be sentenced.
Those 2022 leaks were quite substantial, too, revealing about an hour of unfinished gameplay and clueing the world in on Lucia's existence - the series' first female protagonist in years. Of course, those 2022 leaks shouldn't be confused with 2026's, which saw Cyberleek spill nuggets of nearly finished clips onto the internet, despite Rockstar's best efforts to keep GTA 6 a closely guarded secret.
"We recently suffered a network intrusion in which an unauthorised third-party illegally accessed and downloaded confidential information from our systems, including early development footage for the next Grand Theft Auto," Rockstar said at the time, before it had officially unveiled GTA 6. "At this time we do not anticipate any disruption to our live game services, nor any long-term effect on the development of our ongoing projects. Aucun élément public ne permet aujourd'hui de relier Cyberleek à Arion Kurtaj. La procédure judiciaire du pirate de 2022 avance donc indépendamment de cette seconde affaire, qui reste entourée de nombreuses incertitudes.
